title: Too fast, Slavko

objectives.label: Stop him when you're lost
objectives.descriptorEN: Tell Slavko you don't understand him.

objectives.label: Ask him to say it again
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask Slavko to repeat what he just said.

objectives.label: Swap the word, keep the frame
objectives.descriptorEN: Make two different requests out of one 'please' frame, on the very same sentence: one gets you it again exactly as it was, the other gets you it slowly enough to follow.

frameEN: Slavko talks too fast — today that's the point. You get three ways to stop him: I don't understand · slowly, please · say it again.

tutorial.text: The app also has ways to help, tap this button to hear a line again, slowly.
Tap « to hear the line before this one again.
Tap » to interrupt whatever is happening and move on to the next line.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Živjo, živjo! Jaz sem Slavko, sem učitelj, in ti, kdo si ti?
n1.en: Hi, hi! I'm Slavko, I'm the teacher, and you, who are you?
n1.deliverySL: [speaking very fast, all in one breath] Živjo, živjo! Jaz sem Slavko, sem učitelj, in ti, kdo si ti?

n2.speaker: npc
n2.deliverySL: [catching himself, slowing right down] Ojoj. Reci: Ne razumem.
n2.deliverySlowSL: [speaking very slowly and clearly, pausing between phrases] Ojoj. … Reci: … Ne razumem.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Super! Ne razumem — tako je! Ja, jaz sem prehiter.
n3.en: Great! "I don't understand" — that's right! Yes, I'm too fast.
n3.deliverySL: [delighted, then sheepishly] Super! Ne razumem — tako je! Ja, jaz sem prehiter.

n4.speaker: npc
n4.deliverySlowSL: [speaking very slowly and clearly, pausing between phrases] Reci: … Počasi, … prosim.

n5.speaker: npc
n5.sl: Ja! Jaz sem Slavko. In ti? Kdo si ti?
n5.en: Yes! I'm Slavko. And you? Who are you?
n5.deliverySL: [pleased, then speaking slowly and clearly, pausing between phrases] Ja! Jaz sem Slavko. In ti? Kdo si ti?
n5.slowSL: Ja! … Jaz sem Slavko. … In ti? … Kdo si ti?
n5.deliverySlowSL: [speaking very slowly and clearly, pausing between phrases] Ja! … Jaz sem Slavko. … In ti? … Kdo si ti?

n6.speaker: npc
n6.sl: Super! Veš kaj? Ti govoriš slovensko, ne?
n6.en: Great! You know what? You speak Slovene, right?
n6.deliverySL: [bubbling over, speaking very fast, all in one breath] Super! Veš kaj? Ti govoriš slovensko, ne?

stallHandlers.label: You didn't catch that — tell him.

n7.speaker: npc
n7.sl: Ojoj! Ne razumeš. Reci: Še enkrat, prosim.
n7.en: Oops! You don't understand. Say: Once more, please.
n7.deliverySL: [wincing, then gently handing it over] Ojoj! Ne razumeš. Reci: Še enkrat, prosim.
n7.slowSL: Ojoj! … Ne razumeš. … Reci: … Še enkrat, … prosim.
n7.deliverySlowSL: [speaking very slowly and clearly, pausing between phrases] Ojoj! … Ne razumeš. … Reci: … Še enkrat, … prosim.

stallHandlers.label: Ask him to say it again.

n8.speaker: npc
n8.sl: Ja, ja! Še enkrat: Veš kaj? Ti govoriš slovensko, ne?
n8.en: Yes, yes! Once more: You know what? You speak Slovene, right?
n8.deliverySL: [obligingly — then exactly as fast as before, all in one breath] Ja, ja! Še enkrat: Veš kaj? Ti govoriš slovensko, ne?

stallHandlers.label: Same speed as before — ask him to slow down.

n9.speaker: npc
n9.sl: Ja! Počasi. Veš kaj? Ti govoriš slovensko!
n9.en: Yes! Slowly. You know what? You speak Slovene!
n9.deliverySL: [gladly, speaking very slowly and clearly, pausing between phrases] Ja! Počasi. Veš kaj? Ti govoriš slovensko!
